rules: All seven strategies are in scope; implementation order below.
The reference for each strategy is the RETAINED MT5 version (I18 kept every incumbent except Scalping, whose development-period best is S20). I18 candidates that were not retained are not migrated.

Earlier LEAN work is SIGNAL-LAYER translation only and must not be called a complete migration: quantconnect_20260920 (C7Signals.cs, S1/S4 signals with an engineering order/risk wrapper), lean_500_20260927 (same S1/S4 signals with a 500 USD engineering risk/fill model) and mt5_iteration9_20261004/algorithm (I9 SevenSignalsAlgorithm: signal layer of all seven strategies S1-S6 + Scalping). None of them reproduces the MT5 fill, exit, protection and account-risk lifecycle of the retained versions.

Comparison order per strategy: (1) clock/time mapping, (2) indicators on native closed bars, (3) zones/structures, (4) signals and gates, (5) risk sizing and portfolio caps, (6) fees/swap, (7) fills/latency and exits. A later layer is compared only after the earlier one matches or its residual difference is explained.
Any strategy change discovered during migration is a new experiment with its own registration and budget; migration itself must not change MT5 behaviour.

LEAN currently cannot start on this machine: Windows application control (CodeIntegrity 0x800711C7) blocks QuantConnect DLLs (lean_probe_01). Security policy is not changed and DLLs are not moved, renamed or re-signed to bypass it.
Score N/A (SCORE_TARGETS_UNSET). I18 MT5 numbers are never LEAN numbers.
